Paris
Moving in Paris

Paris

From eastern Paris (11th, 12th, 20th) to the whole city, CODEM organises your move: access, floors, parking and permits are all prepared.

How much is the Paris parking permit?

According to the City of Paris, per vehicle: €17 to €40 for a light vehicle and €35 to €90 for a heavy one, depending on duration and location. A furniture lift has its own rate.

Quote from Paris01 71 36 18 38
01

Homes and access

Haussmann buildings, service staircases, inner courtyards and small lifts: we study every access and plan a furniture lift when needed.

02

Truck parking

In Paris, parking a removal vehicle requires a temporary occupation permit (AOT) from the City, requested online at least 15 days ahead. It is needed to park outside paid bays, for more than 6 hours, or for a furniture lift. Moves are allowed from 7 am to 8 pm.

03

Location and transport

Our Nogent-sur-Marne office is at the gates of Paris, next to the Bois de Vincennes: eastern Paris is our everyday ground.

94130
Moving in Nogent-sur-Marne

Nogent-sur-Marne

Our office is in Nogent-sur-Marne, at 39 boulevard de Strasbourg. We know every neighbourhood, from the riverside to the residential streets, and we work as neighbours.

Can you come quickly in Nogent-sur-Marne?

Our office is right here, so surveys and planning are easier to schedule. Call us for an urgent request.

Quote from Nogent-sur-Marne01 71 36 18 38
01

Homes and access

Riverside houses, detached homes with gardens and newer residences: every home has its own access. Narrow stairs, gates, driveways: we study the furniture’s path from the room to the truck.

02

Truck parking

In Val-de-Marne towns, parking a removal truck on the street requires a municipal order, requested from the town hall ahead of the date. On roads classed as major traffic routes, the request goes to the State services (DRIEAT), online. Your CODEM adviser checks the right procedure and timing with you.

03

Location and transport

Nogent is served by RER A (Nogent-sur-Marne station) and RER E (Nogent – Le Perreux station). Handy for a home survey appointment.

94300
Moving in Vincennes

Vincennes

Between the woods and Paris, Vincennes has many older buildings, often on upper floors and sometimes without a large lift. CODEM plans your move around this access.

My building’s lift is too small. What can be done?

Furniture is dismantled and protected for the stairs, and a furniture lift is considered for bulky items, depending on the facade and the space outside.

Quote from Vincennes01 71 36 18 38
01

Homes and access

Older buildings, narrow staircases, small lifts: we protect shared areas, dismantle what needs to be and consider a furniture lift when the stairs are not enough.

02

Truck parking

In Val-de-Marne towns, parking a removal truck on the street requires a municipal order, requested from the town hall ahead of the date. On roads classed as major traffic routes, the request goes to the State services (DRIEAT), online. Your CODEM adviser checks the right procedure and timing with you.

03

Location and transport

Vincennes is linked to Paris by metro line 1 (Bérault, Château de Vincennes) and RER A (Vincennes station), a few minutes from our Nogent office.

Moving in Saint-Mandé

Saint-Mandé

Saint-Mandé, between Paris 12th, Vincennes and the woods, is home to characterful flats and carefully furnished interiors. We move furniture, artwork and fragile items there with suitable protection.

Can you move artwork and a piano?

Yes. Valuables are custom-packed, and the declaration of value sets the cover. Mention them in your request.

Homes and access

Truck parking

In Val-de-Marne towns, parking a removal truck on the street requires a municipal order, requested from the town hall ahead of the date. On roads classed as major traffic routes, the request goes to the State services (DRIEAT), online. Your CODEM adviser checks the right procedure and timing with you.

03

Moving in Saint-Maur-des-Fossés

Saint-Maur-des-Fossés

In the loop of the Marne, Saint-Maur-des-Fossés has many houses with gardens and residences. Large volumes, cellars, garages, outdoor items: we plan everything with you.

How do I estimate a house’s volume?

Use our room-by-room calculator, then your adviser confirms it during a home or video survey.

Quote from Saint-Maur-des-Fossés01 71 36 18 38
01

Homes and access

Multi-level houses, cellars and outbuildings: the volume is calculated room by room and the team is sized accordingly. Remember garden furniture and the garage.

02

Truck parking

In Saint-Maur, truck parking requires a municipal order. Orders published by the town provide for signs to be put up by the technical services 48 hours ahead outside blue zones, and 7 days ahead inside blue zones: so plan the request early.

03

Location and transport

Saint-Maur is served by RER A (Saint-Maur – Créteil, Le Parc de Saint-Maur, Champigny) and is a few minutes from our Nogent office.

Fontenay-sous-Bois combines residential districts, apartment blocks and the Val de Fontenay business hub. CODEM moves households and offices there.

Yes. Workstations, records and furniture are inventoried and labelled; the move can be organised outside working hours if needed.

Le Perreux-sur-Marne

Next to Nogent, Le Perreux-sur-Marne is a residential town with many detached houses. Our office is close by, so surveys and planning are easy to arrange.

How long does a house move take?

It depends on volume and access. The volume calculator and the survey set the duration and team size.
